sample.title: Why India Won’t Break Up With Russia
sample.description:
India has spent decades balancing its ties to Russia, and the USSR before it, with those to the US. Today, Russia remains a major supplier of oil and weapons to India, just as India builds deeper economic and strategic ties with the US. 

And while India and Russia have changed over time, their relationship remains strong. Even amid the Kremlin’s war on Ukraine and intense pressure from Washington, New Delhi won’t let Moscow go. So why does India keep Russia so close, and can it keep up this balancing act?

sample.title: Inside Bracket22, A Trading Firm Powered By Al Agents
sample.description:
Brian Kelly previously ran a cryptocurrency hedge fund, but closed that shop in early 2025. Later that year, he began testing out uses of artificial intelligence. Bracket22 invests only Kelly's own capital and trades cryptocurrencies, stocks and commodities. It's powered entirely by AI agents — a stark example of a growing reality on Wall Street as firms test the benefits and limits of AI in finance.

sample.description:
European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen proposed a social media ban for children under 13 and restricted access for those between 13 and 15 as she warned about the dangers of online services to minors.

sample.title: AI creations could become 'new silicon species' says head of Microsoft AI | BBC News
sample.description:
Tech treating AI like humans is "mistaken and misguided", according to a leader in Artificial Intelligence.
 
Chief Executive of Microsoft AI Mustafa Suleyman speaks to Nick Robinson for BBC Radio 4's Today Programme, explaining why he thinks that if firms continue to develop AIs that set their own objectives, they are "essentially seeding a new silicon species which will no doubt compete with us for resources".
 
The comments are the latest in a series of stark warnings from the AI industry on the possible dangers of the technology.

But, in a statement, the Palace said the King's "mindful that the pain of fraternal grief can cloud reason, affect judgment and colour memory".
